visual.description: Deep dark olive green used as the dominant hero and primary dark section backgrounds throughout the site.
Warm cream/linen used for all light-mode section backgrounds, alternating rhythmically with the dark olive green.
Pure white for all headings, navigation labels, logo mark, and CTA button text on dark olive backgrounds.
Dark olive green for headings and all body copy rendered on cream/light section backgrounds.
Medium warm olive used for large statistical display numbers and highlighted data callouts on cream backgrounds.
Soft sage green for secondary/caption body text, decorative snowflake icons, and horizontal rule dividers on dark backgrounds.
Muted olive-gray used for card borders, section rule lines, and the gradient mid-tone in transitions between dark and light regions.
